maria (PM): Heads-up — Beacon pilot kickoff slipped into next sprint. Need cross-team alignment on launch criteria, sequencing, and minimal scope for canary. Product wants a canary by 4/21.
alex (eng-runtime): Quick Q — do we have GPU capacity reserved for that canary window? I didn't budget dedicated nodes yet.
sam (infra): We can carve 2 A100s from the staging pool for 2 weeks, but need cost sign-off from infra finance. That gives ~200 qps for short bursts.
jin (security): Security hold: Beacon requires customer-managed KMS/HSM for keys. I need 3 business days to validate HSM integration path and threat model.
tara (prod-ops): Proposed launch checklist (minimal): perf SLOs, telemetry hooks, canary % (5-10%), rollback plan, alert pages, and KMS integration verification.
alex (eng-runtime): For perf SLOs we need sample seq lengths and batch behavior. If we run perf with 512 token median and batch=8 we can estimate p50/p95/p99. I can spin a quick job — need input dataset.
maria (PM): I'll pull a 1000-sample prompt set from Beacon. Will drop link and a short doc with acceptance criteria.
sam (infra): Important sequencing note — HSM provisioning for private pilots takes ~5 days in our vendor timeline. If Beacon insists on HSM in prod, we need to delay or accept a fallback.
jin (security): Fallback option: envelope encryption with our KMS and full audit logging + customer notification. Compliance flagged this as acceptable for pilot if documented. Need waiver ticket.
tara (prod-ops): Can we split the canary: public-hosted variant without HSM for functional validation, and a private-ready variant with HSM gated for GA? That reduces risk.
alex (eng-runtime): That split is doable. Runtime will expose a flag to switch key provider and a quantized model variant for cost. But quantized variant needs quality validation against Beacon prompts. I can run A/B output diffs.
maria (PM): Beacon's obvious requirement: <2s median token latency at 64 tokens, p95 <5s, and no >3% quality regression vs baseline.
jin (security): Can you add that to the waiver request: pilot uses envelope fallback; security will hold for HSM GA. I'll put the draft waiver in the ticket.
sam (infra): Cost tradeoff: dedicated pool for Beacon isolates noisy neighbors but adds ~$10k/month. Shared ded. with tenant pinning cheaper for pilot. Recommend shared-dedicated canary first.
altarops: ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: canary-window requested 2026-04-21T09:00 -> 2026-04-23T17:00 by maria. Confirm resource allocation? :gear:
ops-bot: @sam — staging carve request created (#INC-3482).
alex (eng-runtime): Action list: 1) perf run with Beacon prompts (owner: alex, due: 1775001250). 2) A/B quality diff for quantized model (owner: alex, due: 1775001280).
jin (security): Action: draft HSM waiver ticket and initial threat model (owner: jin, due: 1775001260).
sam (infra): Action: cost tradeoff doc + allocate 2 GPUs for the window (owner: sam, due: 1775001270).
tara (prod-ops): I'll assemble the launch checklist and gate decisions (owner: tara, due: 1775001290).
maria (PM): If all green, we run split canary: hosted variant + private-ready variant with envelope fallback. We communicate tradeoffs to Beacon and get ack.
alex (eng-runtime): Noted — will paste perf logs and a short runbook for rollback steps into the ticket when done.
jin (security): Reminder: no customer keys on our hosts until HSM is validated. Envelope fallback should store key metadata and audit events in the secure log.
tara (prod-ops): Quick ask — who owns the customer comms for the fallback? maria?
maria (PM): I'll own comms. Plan: notify Beacon about pilot fallback in initial SOW and in the pilot kickoff email.
sam (infra): I put the provisional budget estimate in the carve request. If finance declines, option B: reduce canary window to 24h and run extended telemetry.
ops-bot: @channel — checklist template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pilot-checklist — fill PR before end of day.
maria (PM): Ok team — sync standup at 10:30 to confirm owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
